title_en: Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Deepening the Reform of the "Diversion, Mediation, Adjudication, and Trial" Mechanism in People's Courts
keywords_en: traffic accident; securities; arbitration; intellectual property rights; labor disputes
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Opinion on Deepening the Reform of the "Diversion, Mediation, Fast-track Adjudication, and Speedy Trial" Mechanism in the People's Courts

Fa Fa [2020] No. 8

To implement the overall requirements of the Fourth Plenary Session of the 19th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China on upholding and improving the socialist system with Chinese characteristics and advancing the modernization of the national governance system and governance capacity, to implement the Party Central Committee's deployments such as deepening the comprehensive and coordinated reform of the judicial system, to further optimize the allocation of judicial resources, to meet the judicial needs of the people, to promote the construction of a layered, integrated, and interconnected one-stop diversified dispute resolution mechanism that combines simple and complex procedures, and to improve the quality and efficiency of resolving conflicts and disputes, this Opinion is formulated in light of the actual work of the people's courts, concerning the deepening of the reform of the "diversion, mediation, fast-track adjudication, and speedy trial" mechanism.

I. Improving the Litigation and Non-Litigation Diversion and Docking Mechanism

1. Improve the diversion mechanism between litigation and non-litigation dispute resolution methods. Strengthen the diversion between litigation and non-litigation methods such as mediation, arbitration, administrative reconsideration, and administrative adjudication. Provide legal guidance and model judgment cases, or assign personnel to be stationed, at comprehensive or specialized conflict resolution centers established within the province (autonomous region, municipality) for family, medical, property, housing, land, finance, insurance, securities, environmental, intellectual property, labor disputes, consumer rights, and road traffic accident damage compensation matters, to ensure that non-litigation dispute resolution centers carry out mediation and resolution work first. Explore the establishment of pre-trial reconciliation (mediation) centers for administrative disputes to promote the substantive resolution of administrative disputes. Establish and improve the diversion mechanism among litigation, administrative reconsideration, administrative adjudication, and arbitration. Conduct inquiry and questioning regarding the dispute resolution methods in the prosecution materials before filing the case. For disputes that should or may undergo administrative reconsideration, administrative adjudication, or arbitration first, inform or guide the parties to initiate administrative reconsideration, choose administrative adjudication, or apply to an arbitration institution.

2. Accelerate the construction of an integrated dispute resolution mechanism. Further expand the reform achievements of the "online data integration" for road traffic accident damage compensation disputes. For frequent and high-incidence disputes such as banking and insurance, securities and futures, labor disputes, and consumption, establish an integrated dispute resolution mechanism under the leadership of the Party committee, in conjunction with trade unions, public security, financial, market supervision, human resources and social security departments, unify law enforcement and judicial standards and evidence rules, achieve co-construction and sharing of information resources, and promote efficient dispute resolution prior to litigation.

3. Strengthen online litigation and non-litigation diversion. Accelerate the docking of the People's Court Mediation Platform with other non-litigation dispute resolution platforms such as arbitration, notarization, people's mediation, commercial mediation, industry mediation, and lawyer mediation, forming an online linkage work system between litigation and non-litigation dispute resolution methods. After a party enters dispute information on the People's Court Mediation Platform, the system automatically recommends available dispute resolution methods and the most suitable dispute resolution plan. For those who choose manual consultation, provide dispute resolution guidance through the 12368 litigation service hotline. For parties who directly apply for case filing through the online case filing platform, the system intelligently pushes whether to agree to the pre-litigation mediation confirmation letter based on the case circumstances. If the party agrees to pre-litigation mediation, the case is transferred to the People's Court Mediation Platform.

4. Promote the automatic performance of non-litigation mediation. Non-litigation mediation should focus on the authenticity, legality, and enforceability of the mediation content, ensuring that the subjects of rights and obligations are clear and the content of performance is definite. Establish a positive incentive mechanism for the automatic performance of non-litigation mediation, such as incorporating the automatic performance status into the credit evaluation system, to guide parties to voluntarily perform and execute mediation agreements on the spot, promptly resolving conflicts and disputes locally.

5. Enhance the quality and efficiency of judicial confirmation. Promote basic people's courts and people's tribunals, as well as intermediate people's courts and specialized people's courts included in the pilot reform of simplified and diversified civil procedure, to conduct guidance, training, and judicial confirmation work relying on the People's Court Mediation Platform. If a mediation agreement is reached through mediation assigned by the court, the parties may apply to the court that made the assignment for judicial confirmation. Formulate unified templates for mediation agreements, judicial confirmation applications, etc., to enhance the level of standardization. Strengthen the screening and verification of judicial confirmation for cases such as private lending, to prevent malicious collusion in mediation, false litigation, and other acts.

6. Establish and improve the pre-litigation guidance mechanism. Set up a litigation consultation, guidance, and evaluation area in the litigation service center, equipped with litigation counselors and corresponding smart devices, providing self-service services such as litigation outcome evaluation. Before registration and case filing, court staff, stationed lawyers, psychological counselors, specially invited mediators, people's assessors, retired judges, volunteers, etc., act as litigation counselors to conduct litigation and non-litigation diversion, guiding the parties to choose the most suitable method to resolve the dispute.

II. Improving the Mediation and Fast-Track Adjudication Diversion and Docking Mechanism

7. Comprehensively carry out mediation diversion work. For civil disputes brought to the people's court, except for those unsuitable for mediation based on the nature of the case or those already mediated but unable to reach a mediation agreement, a confirmation letter on whether to agree to mediation shall be issued to the parties before case filing. If the parties agree to pre-litigation mediation, assigned mediation shall be conducted. If the parties disagree, the case shall be registered and filed according to law. If the parties agree to mediation after case filing, entrusted mediation shall be conducted, or court-appointed mediators shall conduct pre-trial mediation. If the parties disagree with pre-litigation or pre-trial mediation, the case shall be immediately transferred to the trial procedure. For cases where both parties have entrusted lawyers for representation, encourage voluntary reconciliation before trial. For administrative disputes such as administrative compensation and compensation that are suitable for mediation, explore the establishment of assigned and entrusted mediation systems. For criminal private prosecution cases, encourage voluntary reconciliation or third-party mediation on the basis of voluntariness and legality. For cases applying for compulsory enforcement, encourage the obligor to voluntarily perform the obligations determined by effective legal documents through mediation.

8. Use the People's Court Mediation Platform to conduct mediation. Fully utilize the People's Court Mediation Platform to integrate dispute resolution forces such as trade unions, Communist Youth League, Women's Federation, Law Society, administrative organs, arbitration institutions, notary institutions, industry associations, industry organizations, people's mediation committees, chambers of commerce, and lawyers. Include all organizations and individuals that meet the selection qualifications for specially invited mediation organizations and specially invited mediators in the specially invited mediation roster and record them on the platform. Rosters established by higher-level courts can be used by lower-level courts. Gradually expand the mediation matters of the People's Court Mediation Platform from civil disputes to administrative disputes, criminal private prosecution cases, and enforcement cases, ensuring that assigned mediation or entrusted mediation after case filing is all conducted on the People's Court Mediation Platform.

9. Strengthen online audio and video mediation. Improve the level of online mediation, widely apply audio and video methods such as video, telephone, and WeChat to conduct online mediation work. Parties can directly submit online mediation applications on the People's Court Mediation Platform, fill in electronic service addresses, upload relevant evidence materials, etc., and mediators conduct online mediation. For cases mediated online, mediation agreements, records, etc., can be confirmed through online methods such as electronic signatures. The People's Court Mediation Platform is interconnected with the case filing system. For applications for issuing legal documents, mediation materials are directly imported into the case filing system. After case filing, in principle, connect with all parties online to verify the mediation situation. Upon review, if the judge deems it truly necessary, both parties can be notified to appear together for verification. With the consent of the parties, litigation documents can be electronically served according to law.

10. Improve the integrated mediation and adjudication registration and transfer mechanism. For cases subject to assigned mediation, entrusted mediation, or pre-trial mediation after diversion by the court, the complaint and other relevant materials shall be scanned and recorded into the mediation platform. The mediator is responsible for contacting the other party, guiding the completion of the "Service Address Confirmation Letter," organizing mediation, etc. Mediation information recording, work transfer, agreement generation, mediation and adjudication docking, etc., are all conducted on the mediation platform. Mediation shall be completed within thirty days, which may be appropriately extended with the consent of both parties. If a mediation agreement is reached and performed immediately, the mediator records the result in the system. If a legal document is required, it is transferred to the fast-track adjudication and speedy trial team for processing. If mediation fails within the prescribed time limit, the case is divided into simple and complex cases. Simple cases are continued to be handled by the fast-track adjudication and speedy trial team.

11. Strengthen the compilation of mediation case numbers. For civil, administrative, enforcement, and criminal private prosecution cases subject to pre-litigation mediation on the People's Court Mediation Platform, the case number is compiled as "Year of Case Acceptance + Court Code + Case Type + Pre-Litigation Mediation + Case Number". If a party applies for appraisal or evaluation, the people's court issues relevant procedures using the above case number. For entrusted mediation, the case number is compiled as "Year of Case Acceptance + Court Code + Case Type + Entrusted Mediation + Case Number". The case number on the mediation platform is automatically linked with the case number in the trial process management system, enabling traceability, inquiry, and statistics of the entire mediation case process.

12. Clarify the principle of jurisdiction of the first-filed case in pre-litigation mediation. If a party applies for pre-litigation mediation, the statute of limitations is interrupted from the date the party files a lawsuit with the people's court. If the case is transferred for case filing due to failure to reach a mediation agreement, in the event of a dispute over jurisdiction, the time of compiling the "Pre-Litigation Mediation" case number shall serve as the basis for determining the jurisdiction of the first-filed case.

III. Improving the Standards for Dividing Simple and Complex Cases

13. Standards for dividing simple and complex civil cases. Except for the following cases unsuitable for fast-track adjudication and speedy trial, the basic people's court and people's tribunal shall treat other first-instance civil cases where the facts are clear, the relationship of rights and obligations is definite, and the dispute is not substantial as simple cases for diversion:

(1) New types of cases;
(2) Cases related to bankruptcy;
(3) Cases where one party or both parties have a large number of persons;
(4) Cases remanded for retrial by a higher people's court;
(5) Cases applying to the trial supervision procedure;
(6) Third-party revocation actions;
(7) Actions of objection to enforcement;
(8) Cases involving national interests or social public interests;
(9) Cases with high social attention and whose judgment results have model significance.

The standards for dividing simple and complex cases in first-instance civil cases of intermediate people's courts shall be determined with reference to the above standards, while also considering the amount in controversy and other circumstances.

For appeal cases where the first-instance court concluded the case using fast-track adjudication and speedy trial, cases where the party withdraws the appeal or withdraws the lawsuit, cases treated as automatic withdrawal of appeal, and cases appealing against rulings on non-acceptance, dismissal of lawsuit, or jurisdictional objection, the second-instance court shall generally treat them as simple cases for diversion. Higher people's courts may explore the division of simple and complex cases for civil applications for retrial.

Local people's courts may formulate specific standards for dividing civil cases based on actual circumstances.

14. Standards for dividing simple and complex criminal cases. For first-instance criminal cases in basic people's courts that meet the conditions for applying the criminal summary procedure and criminal fast-track procedure as stipulated in Articles 214 and 222 of the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, they shall generally be treated as simple cases for diversion.

15. Standards for dividing simple and complex administrative cases. Intermediate and basic people's courts shall treat the following administrative cases as simple cases for diversion:

(1) Cases falling under the circumstances specified in Article 82, Paragraphs 1 and 2 of the Administrative Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China;
(2) Administrative cases concerning trademark authorization and confirmation where the facts are clear, the relationship of rights and obligations is definite, and the dispute is not substantial;
(3) Cases concerning lawsuits against administrative organs for performing duties;
(4) Cases involving complaints or reports, demanding performance of hierarchical supervision, and other non-litigation review cases.

The standards for dividing simple and complex administrative second-instance cases may be determined with reference to civil cases.

16. Standards for dividing simple and complex enforcement cases. The people's court shall treat the following enforcement cases as simple cases for diversion:

(1) Cases where the person subject to enforcement provides deposits, funds in non-bank payment institutions, etc., that can be directly transferred to fully satisfy the debt;
(2) Cases where the property of the person subject to enforcement can be promptly liquidated to fully satisfy the debt;
(3) Cases where the person subject to enforcement has been found to have no property available for enforcement in other cases during the same period;
(4) Preservation enforcement cases.

IV. Establishing and Improving the Fast-Track Adjudication, Speedy Trial, and Speedy Enforcement Mechanism

17. Improve the dedicated team centralized processing system. Establish case diversion clerks responsible for mediation and adjudication diversion and division of simple and complex cases. Strengthen the construction of civil fast-track adjudication and speedy trial teams, promote the establishment of administrative fast-track adjudication and speedy trial teams, promote the integration of mediators with teams, and carry out mediation, fast-track adjudication, and speedy trial work in the litigation service center or other diversified dispute resolution venues. Promote the establishment of criminal fast-track adjudication and speedy trial teams, set up criminal fast-track areas or fast-track courts in detention centers, litigation service centers, etc., to conduct criminal fast-track procedures and quick trial of simple cases. Explore the establishment of speedy enforcement teams to promote quick enforcement of simple cases.

18. Improve the mechanism for converting simple civil and administrative cases to complex cases. Upon receiving a case, the civil and administrative fast-track adjudication and speedy trial team shall review within three working days whether there are circumstances such as the party being unlocatable, the need for investigation, evidence collection, inspection, audit, appraisal, or evaluation, or the case being complicated and unsuitable for fast-track adjudication and speedy trial. If such circumstances exist, raise an objection immediately, and the case diversion clerk shall withdraw the case and divert it as a complex case. If during the fast-track adjudication or speedy trial period, circumstances arise that make the case complex, the presiding judge shall submit an application for conversion from simple to complex within two working days after the occurrence of such circumstances. After review and approval, the case diversion clerk shall transfer the case to another specialized team judge for handling and notify the parties.

19. Promote the simplification of litigation procedures for cases subject to fast-track adjudication, speedy trial, and speedy enforcement. For cases that meet the application conditions for small claims procedure or criminal fast-track procedure, automatically apply the small claims or criminal fast-track procedure. For other simple cases, apply summary procedure, order procedure, ordinary procedure, etc., for simplified and speedy handling. Promote the practice of handling simple cases in concentrated time slots. Simple cases can be filed, tried, and announced in a concentrated manner, with the same trial team continuously hearing multiple cases in the same time period. While legally protecting the litigation rights of the parties, further simplify the trial procedures. Use simple methods such as litigation platforms, telephone, mobile phone text messages, fax, email, instant messaging accounts, etc., to notify the parties. If both parties indicate that they do not need a period for evidence submission or defense, the court may proceed directly to trial. If the parties have already exercised their right of defense, the trial time is not restricted by the evidence submission period or defense period. Explore the use of remote video trials or online methods for hearings, and promote the use of electronic signatures and electronic service methods. Further simplify judgment documents, briefly fill in the parties' information, reasoning, and judgment results. Explore simplifying property investigation in enforcement cases. For cases where the person subject to enforcement has been found to have no property available for enforcement in other cases during the same period, if the applying party for enforcement has no objection to the property status of the person subject to enforcement, property investigation may no longer be conducted.

20. Promote factor-based trials and model judgments. Gradually promote factor-based trials for disputes such as financial loan contract disputes, private lending disputes, sales contract disputes, motor vehicle traffic accident liability disputes, labor disputes, divorce disputes, property service contract disputes, credit card disputes, government information disclosure, and administrative disputes over trademark authorization and confirmation. Have the parties fill in case factor forms, simplify the trial procedure around the case factors, and use factor-based judgment documents. For multiple parties filing the same type or series of simple civil or administrative cases, first select one case to conduct a model judgment, establish a judgment standard, and handle other cases in batches with reference to the model case.

21. Establish process management suitable for the characteristics of fast-track adjudication and speedy trial. Cases subject to fast-track adjudication procedures shall generally be assigned on the same day, tried in one session, pronounced in court, and served on the spot. For cases adjudicated using fast-track adjudication procedures, they shall generally be concluded within ten days, with a maximum of fifteen days; for cases handled using speedy trial and speedy enforcement procedures, they shall generally be concluded within thirty days, with a maximum of sixty days. However, the time elapsed during the fast-track adjudication or speedy trial period due to the party adding or changing litigation claims, filing a counterclaim, or raising a jurisdictional objection shall not be included in the above time limits. If the trial period specified by law or judicial interpretation is shorter than the above time limits, such law or judicial interpretation shall apply.

V. Strengthening Supporting Safeguards

22. Strengthen overall coordination. Incorporate the "diversion, mediation, fast-track adjudication, and speedy trial" work into the social governance system led by the Party committee, responsible by the government, with democratic consultation, social coordination, public participation, legal guarantees, and technological support for planning and deployment. Establish a coordination group led by a court leader and involving relevant departments to coordinate and promote the work. Strengthen connection and coordination with relevant government departments regarding litigation and non-litigation diversion docking and diversified dispute resolution. Coordinate with relevant departments to strengthen funding guarantees, incorporate diversified mediation work into the overall funding arrangement for diversified resolution of conflicts and disputes, and reasonably guarantee the funding needed for mediators to carry out their work.

23. Select and strengthen mediation, fast-track adjudication, and speedy trial teams. Strengthen connection with the judicial administrative department, further improve mediator selection and training, establish and improve mediator performance evaluation and incentive mechanisms, and regularly assess the number of cases mediated by mediators, mediation rates, and automatic performance rates. People's courts at all levels shall equip corresponding numbers of fast-track adjudication and speedy trial teams based on the volume of cases in their region, select presiding judges, adequately equip judge assistants and support personnel, clarify the list of powers and responsibilities, and form a trial management mechanism adapted to the reform of the "diversion, mediation, fast-track adjudication, and speedy trial" mechanism.

24. Establish a categorized assessment mechanism. Increase the weight of the "diversion, mediation, fast-track adjudication, and speedy trial" work in the performance appraisal system to form an effective incentive mechanism. Include the diversion of pre-litigation disputes, assigned mediation, and guidance on judicial confirmation in the assessment scope to increase the initiative in guiding non-litigation methods to resolve disputes. Scientifically assess the assessment weight of simple and complex cases in the region, conduct comprehensive assessment based on the number of cases, degree of difficulty, applicable procedures, etc., and do not simply use the number of cases as an assessment indicator.

25. Enhance the level of information technology development and application. Local courts develop algorithms for the division of simple and complex cases based on actual conditions and embed them into the case filing system, forming a mode of case division with intelligent identification and system diversion as the mainstay and manual diversion as a supplement. Deepen the application of electronic case files synchronized with the case, promote electronic case file filing and paperless case handling for fast-track adjudication and speedy trial cases, and promote a case archiving method with electronic files as the mainstay and paper files as a supplement. Record the entire trial process with audio and video, explore replacing trial transcripts with audio and video recordings with the consent of the parties. Embed fast-track adjudication and speedy trial modules in the case handling system, add functions for automatic document generation, and develop a judgment document database for common types of cases such as motor vehicle traffic accident liability, property service contracts, credit cards, financial loan contracts, government information disclosure, dangerous driving, and theft, gradually realizing the automatic generation of judgment documents for fast-track adjudication and speedy trial cases.

26. Strengthen publicity and promotion. Further strengthen publicity of non-litigation dispute resolution mechanisms and the People's Court Mediation Platform. Intensify publicity and commendation of outstanding mediators, outstanding fast-track adjudication, and speedy trial teams. Encourage local courts to actively explore, and promptly summarize and promote useful experiences and practices. Use popular and appealing publicity methods to enhance the public's recognition of the "diversion, mediation, fast-track adjudication, and speedy trial" work, creating a favorable reform atmosphere.

February 10, 2020
